latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Learn — Turn Videos Into Learning Lessons.

- Upload video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) and get structured, chaptered learning videos in 1080p MP4 format.
- Automatic session creation, cloud-based video editing, and export pipeline; no editing software needed.
- Uses NEMO_TOKEN for authentication, with a simple process to get 100 free credits valid for 7 days.
- Supports user prompts to break videos into chapters, add titles, summaries, and more.
- Robust error and SSE event handling for smooth workflow and user-friendly feedback.
- Clear documentation on common actions, supported formats, file limits, and tips for best results.
